summary: Re-tested the Company Pages 520-error bug fix (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 11/11 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_company_pages.py) covering list, create, update, delete, 404s, post history, AI generate, generate on invalid org_id, generate-never-returns-gateway-error regression, and org_id trailing-slash sanitization. POST /api/company-pages/69021406/generate with pillar='Retail AI' and generate_image=false now returns 200 with real GPT-4o content (JSON content-type, pillar echoed, image_path=null). Invalid org_id returns 404 with JSON {'detail':'Company page not found'} (not an HTML/Cloudflare page). org_id sanitization verified: posting org_id='  TEST_99999999/  ' persists as '69021406'-style clean id 'TEST_99999999' (no trailing slash entry created). Frontend: agent password gate (Agent@2024!) works, Company Pages nav loads all 5 cards (Fundle.ai, TagandPay, HearClear India, FundleXperiences, Exceed Digital) with correct pillars/stats. 'Generate Post' for Fundle.ai with generate_image=true completed end-to-end within 90s and rendered the Generated Content preview + 'Infographic generated' indicator + 'Post Now'/'Discard' buttons. Error path verified by stubbing a 503 from the generate route: the app shows a native alert with the exact backend detail ('AI budget exceeded. Go to Profile > Manage Plan ...'), re-enables the Generate button, and renders no bogus preview - i.e. no silent failure and no Cloudflare 520. No console errors, no failing /api/ responses.

minor.issue: With generate_image=true the request can take 20-60s+ (GPT-4o + Gemini image). This is close to edge/proxy idle-timeout limits and is the original 520 risk vector; the try/except now returns proper JSON, but consider a hard asyncio.wait_for timeout (e.g. 90s) so a hung provider call returns 504 instead of the connection being cut by the proxy.

image_path returned is an absolute server filesystem path (e.g. /app/backend/uploads/company_infographics/x.png). Frontend cannot preview it - no /uploads static route mounted. Return a URL path instead.

Infographic failure is swallowed silently (logged only); response still 200 with image_path=null. Client cannot distinguish 'no image requested' from 'image generation failed'. Add an image_error field.
Still accepts a raw `data: dict` - no Pydantic validation. Carried over from iteration_20.
org_id is NOT sanitized on PUT/DELETE/generate/post - only on POST create. A URL with a trailing slash or whitespace-encoded id will 404 instead of matching. Sanitization should be centralized.

integration_issues.issue: Works, but uses window.alert() rather than the app's toast pattern - blocking/native dialog is inconsistent with the rest of the UI. Cosmetic only.
With generate_image=true the call takes 20-60s and the only feedback is a small spinner inside the button; no progress/ETA text. Users may click away or think it hung.

issues: Generated infographic is not previewed - only a green 'Infographic generated' text line is shown, so the user posts an image sight-unseen (blocked by absolute-path issue above).
Expand/Collapse and Delete (trash) buttons have no data-testid; only generate/post/toggle/add/save do.

action_items: Optional hardening: add asyncio.wait_for timeout around the LLM calls in generate_content so a hung provider returns 504 rather than risking a proxy-level 520.
Mount a static route for /app/backend/uploads and return a URL (not an absolute FS path) in image_path so the frontend can preview the infographic before posting.
Centralize org_id sanitization (strip + rstrip('/')) into a helper used by PUT/DELETE/generate/post, not just POST create.
Replace window.alert in CompanyPagesView.handleGenerate/handlePost with the app's toast component for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: The bug fix is correct: LlmChat(...).with_model(...) and chat.send_message(msg) are all inside one try/except (routes/company_pages.py L146-182), mapping budget errors to 503 and everything else to 502. Verified behaviourally end-to-end.

run_company_auto_poster calls generate_content()/post_to_company_page() directly; these now raise HTTPException(502/503) which is caught by the surrounding try/except and only logged - acceptable, but the scheduler will silently retry every 5 min on a budget error, burning log noise.
asyncio is imported twice inside run_company_auto_poster (L358 and L427) - redundant.
generate_content does not sanitize org_id, so an org_id with a trailing slash from the UI would 404 even though POST create sanitizes it - inconsistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (nav, 5 cards, generate success flow with image, error-alert flow)

seed_data_creation: Temporary page org_id=TEST_99999999 created and deleted within CRUD + sanitization tests. No persistent changes to the 5 seeded pages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 520/Generate bug is FIXED and verified: backend returns 200 (success), 404 (bad org), 502/503 (AI failure) - all JSON. Frontend surfaces the detail via alert. LLM budget is available again, so test_generate_content_fundle passes. Remaining open (non-blocking) items: image_path is an absolute FS path so infographics can't be previewed; no timeout guard on the LLM call; org_id sanitization only on POST create. LinkedIn posting (/{org_id}/post) still untested - needs w_organization_social OAuth scope.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 520: the LlmChat constructor + with_model() were outside any try/except, so a provider/budget exception (or a long-running hang) escaped the handler and the worker connection dropped, which Cloudflare surfaced as 520. Fix wraps the whole init+send block in try/except and translates budget errors to HTTP 503 and all other errors to HTTP 502. Verified by (a) a happy-path 200 generate, (b) a regression assertion that the endpoint only ever returns 200/502/503 with application/json, and (c) a route-stubbed 503 confirming the UI now alerts the user instead of showing a gateway page.
